title: Read the following two primary source excerpts and answer the prompt below.

documents.label: A
documents.citation: Immigration Act of 1924 (Johnson-Reed Act), Section 11, U.S. Statutes at Large, 68th Congress (public domain)
documents.excerpt: The annual quota of any nationality shall be two per centum of the number of foreign-born individuals of such nationality resident in continental United States as determined by the United States Census of 1890… The annual quota of any nationality for the fiscal year beginning July 1, 1927, and for each fiscal year thereafter, shall be a number which bears the same ratio to 150,000 as the number of inhabitants in continental United States in 1920 having that national origin bears to the number of inhabitants in continental United States in 1920.

documents.label: B
documents.citation: Warren G. Harding, "Return to Normalcy" campaign speech, Boston, Massachusetts, May 14, 1920 (Congressional Record, public domain)
documents.excerpt: America's present need is not heroics but healing; not nostrums but normalcy; not revolution but restoration; not agitation but adjustment… not submergence in internationality but sustainment in triumphant nationality.
